name: value-arms-heldout
decision: Jerry 2026-11-11: 'All sound good' (held-out for the DEV passers T9 and T8, board #1 comment 6788114110).

tables.stac: experiments/stac-va-<arm>.json (ultra; reported only, paired by seed with the 2026-11-09 tiles ladder receipt)

gate: Per candidate, PASS iff both: (1) the self_served evaluator receipt passes (paired-normal LCB > 0 at alpha .05, variance_floor .10, point >= 0, 0 truncations, latency); (2) the JSettlers paired table: scripts/jsettlers_paired.py --alpha 0.05 --expect-games 5120 'pass' (one-sided LCB > 0, healthy, <= 5% excluded) and mean >= 0. Both tables must pass (an intersection-union test: each component at .05 bounds this candidate's false-pass probability by .05). Across the two candidates, fixed-sequence testing: t9 first; t8 is tested only if t9 passes, so the family-wise error stays at .05. If t9 fails, t8's tables are reported but support no claim (Codex HOLD @50267e6).

power.target: joint power >= .80 per candidate at alternative .75 x its DEV point (Codex HOLD @50267e6: target made explicit)
power.jsettlers: 5120 pairs, per-game SD .58 (DEV .574 / .562): pass needs a mean above about +.013; at .75 x the DEV point (t9 +.0205, t8 +.0264) power .812 and .947. Sizes chosen before any held-out game (2048 on 2026-11-10 would give .48 / .66).

reported: STAC POMCP-TS-CR and negotiator win shares with trading, paired with the served tiles ladder (no gate); mean VP; latency
source: all three tables run the DEV code: ultra snapshot vadev-source-v1 and the Mac mini worktree catan-ai-vadevjs, both at 64260248ad1ef8d7bbacaecc7d0e3c5e8ad8e06e
consequence: PASS: supports promoting that candidate (owner's call). FAIL: planner_pv2_tiles stays served; no re-test without a new owner decision.
launch: every external table runs through scripts/cython_run.py: one serial build/bind per checkout, then each run with the environment it sets (CATAN_ENGINE=cython, snapshot src on PYTHONPATH)
